standards.description: The higher an object is lifted, the more gravitational potential energy it has, and the more work it can do when released.
standards.traceDetail: Block-on-shelf model links height and mass to stored energy in joules.

standards.standard: Potential Energy and the Energy of Position
standards.description: Develop a model to describe that when the arrangement of objects interacting at a distance changes, different amounts of potential energy are stored in the system.
standards.traceDetail: Moving the shelf changes height and thus the stored gravitational potential energy, shown on the meter.

standards.description: When two objects interact, each one exerts a force on the other, and these forces can transfer energy between them.
standards.traceDetail: Gravity's pull on the held block is the force that governs its stored potential.
